horoscopes.horoscope: If you are aiming to marry soon, you can start making preparations today. However, before you take the final decision, it would be better to look at both sides of the coin, advises Ganesha. Activities related to such an alliance will dominate today, and by the end of the day you may feel very elated. You will be in a hurry while doing domestic activities with your sweetheart. You feel you need to attract your beloved so that you will have a fantastic evening. You may feel happy teasing your romantic partner and want to share a dream night together. On this lively day, you shall be full of beans. Spend your time to review your strategies and help others. Chalk out a fitness plan and follow it seriously. Do physical activities to boost your stamina, and remain in good shape. It may not be a very favourable day as far as earnings are concerned. But, working sincerely will help generate good money. Ganesha advises you against long term investments. Your superior feels that you are the right person to finish all the tasks and therefore give you the responsibilities. The day brings new projects for you at the work front, since your energy is just about right to take up initiatives, reveals Ganesha.

This is one of those dreadful days when you could be unduly touchy and short tempered, fears Ganesha. Don’t go around getting into fights and quarrels with anyone who seems unfriendly or ill mannered. You will only end up in spoiling some healthy relationships. Your moods are likely change from moment to moment. An ugly row with your spouse cannot be ruled out. Do not endanger your married life. Be firm with yourself and keep your irritability under full control. You should breathe a fresh air since there is no hassle foreseen at the love front. Your romantic life will play an important role today as you are likely to think for your future. You will feel safe and secured in the arms of your sweetheart, says Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that you may be prone to mood swings today. You could be pulled in different directions that may prevent you from working efficiently. This is also the right time to get rid of your bad habits and start meditation to remain calm. Since you are too insecure about financial planning, you would do well to seek the help of other people’s, but ensure that they are your well-wishers. You may plan a long-distance trip. Today, you are just not in the right mood to make more efforts. You are likely to feel tired or bored. Challenges will come your way, foresees Ganesha and you need to be prepared to take responsibilities. It will be better for you in the long run if you face challenges now.

It will not be hard for you to complete your tasks succesfully and without any delays or obstacles in your path, only if you first seek to fully understand and acquire the learning required to eprform it. The fruits of your labour will keep you happy and satisfied, says Ganesha. Compromise is the keyword in your love life. When you learn to sacrifice, everything will get changed. You are still immature in the minds of your partner. Your acts may not sound serious to your soulmate. You will better relate to your sweetheart once you are ready to learn his/her lifestyle. You will spend more time and energy in building and maintaining new relations. There will be a strong desire to do something new by expanding your circle. You will also gather more information about things and travel out for the same. You may suddenly feel like taking an initiative to make a friend feel happy, such as treating them to a movie. Well, your cheerfulness will rarely be off but Ganesha advises you not to expect much in return. A good day to schedule maintenance activities. This is the time you need to be alert while coordinating all your activities. You need to focus on pending works. Multitasking will help you perform better in the workplace, feels Ganesha.

You are known for your ability to set the ball rolling. Once you set your mind to do something, it is generally considered done by your peers. Today, you are eyeing a few accomplishments on the monetary front. Most part of your day will go in dealing with financial transactions, and importing and exporting goods. You need to manage your stress. It would be safer if you avoid being selfish with your sweetheart. You are advised to stay away from getting into furious discussions with your beloved. After all, you won’t be happy and you may lose a crucial affair, reminds Ganesha. On this busy day, you may have to run around from pillar to post in order to simultaneously work on many fronts. Yet, you shall not get exhausted, because you are bound to succeed in everything you do today, says Ganesha. Today is so-so on the financial front for you. You need to think of how to improve your investment portfolio by committing to small but regular contributions which will not be too taxing. Precision will be in your mind whenever it comes to performing your tasks today. Ganesha feels that you should embrace new responsibility as a chance to move ahead. Your intuitive mind may be able to lessen complexities of the project. Career-related issues may occupy you for a while, reveals Ganesha.

Today there is a chance that you will meet that special someone that you have been waiting for all your life. You may possibly give your partner a beautiful gift. You will be more inclined towards the arts and will be able to exhibit this new-found appreciation to the max, says Ganesha. Tonight you want to spend the time with your soulmate in a peaceful place. Candlelit dinner would not be a bad idea to bring that romance back in your life. Commitment, compassion, and creativity- these are some sought-after qualities you are expecting from your life partner. It is the time to use your time and energy fruitfully. If you use it for the right tasks, it will help you. However, if you get angry you may lose lot of energy. It is the ideal time for going on biking or some excursions. Foreign connections may give you good ideas or good clients. Gains from distant places can really enthuse you. There are all chances of earning a good sum with the help of people in authority and power. Your original ideas will play a key role in defining success. You are even likely to receive appreciation from your superiors for the jobs well executed. You will feel that you have recently achieved an important status in the workplace, reveals Ganesha.

A fear of the unknown will keep lurking in your mind today. The shadow will only grow larger as the day progresses. You may find yourself spending too much on your foreign friends. Ganesha advises you to be cautious in this regard today. After a hard day, you will like to be alone. It’s sweet to dim the lights and relax with a soothing number on your iPod, feels Ganesha. However, spending a romantic time with sweetheart at the home spa will be sweeter, feels Ganesha. You need to take proper sleep and even ‘power naps’ as the day may drain you easily. You need to take health food. The day will also be more demanding at work. Don’t undertake sports activities or any laborius work. You may also feel that your efforts to earn money are going in vain. However, Ganesha feels that this is a psssing phenomenon. You should not be shaken up by things going wrong today. Pending tasks seem to get finished on time and your computer is expected to get loaded with responsibilities. More complex and critical tasks are coming your way. You are likely to turn more analytical. Patience should be the keyword. However, you will focus more on perfection, feels Ganesha.

Ganesha says your children will gain achievements that will have you feel proud of them. You will get monetary benefit either by increment in salary or by inheritance. You will be able to gain substantial gains by investing in real estate or buying insurance policies. You cannot imagine this beautiful evening without your sweetheart. You are likely to tease and caress your beloved. An intimate evening with your darling is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. You need to remain awake until midnight. Otherwise, you may fall asleep in the arms of your sweetheart. This is a good day to interact with knowledgeable persons to figure out what’s good for your health. You can also ask doctor’s advise, you will be guided properly. Time is not good to start gym but you can do Yoga or other spiritual activities. Ganesha feels that you may spend money to maintain your public image. Avoid ‘big show off’ as it will require ‘big money’ too. It’s very average day for financial success, so avoid taking big risks today. A perfect day of the month calls upon you to improve your relations with people at your workplace. Technical guys will keep themselves busy solving permutations and combinations. You need to be practical while taking up important projects, suggests Ganesha. Productivity will be good at the end of the day.

Yet another mundane day in your life, as nothing exciting is on the cards. However, be cheerful and keep trying hard to bring in some spice in life. You never know when the planets change their mood and make an exciting future. Keep the hope alive, says Ganesha. You may be fascinated with some lovely gifts that you are planning to present to your loved one. You will like to amuse your partner, feels Ganesha. You both will eventually spend a wonderful time together sharing some amazing moments. Expect to remain busy like a bee on this challenging day. You may get up in low spirits, and lack energy to do routine tasks. Your work may not get accomplished as expected, and cause dissatisfaction. Visit your doctor – today! Do not squander your money today, and at the same time avoid taking debts, or you may find it difficult repay. However, you may go ahead and apply for loans, if you need to. You will feel lazy today and not in a mood to work. You may tend to escape from your responsibilities. However, Ganesha says it will only hamper your reputation. If you remain committed strictly to your profession now, half of the job will get done and you may need to work less later, says Ganesha.

Your leadership qualities are likely to bag compliments today. As you follow law and order and also make others follow it. You leave no stone unturned to get the work done, and that too systematically. However, make sure you also give them space and freedom to express themselves. It would earn you brownie points, says Ganesha. An entertaining evening awaits you as you may go for a movie with your partner or friends. You may grab a wonderful chance to spend the night with someone special. You will feel happy when you please your sweetheart with your fun. Today your energy level may dip, and adversely affect your performance in office. This indicates that you deserve a break from your tight work schedule. Expend more time with your parents, spouse and kids. They will be more than happy. Mostly, the day is in your favour for financial matters. You should avoid spending heavily on travel plans, feels Ganesha, as it may burn a big hole in your pocket. Your mind seems to be brimming with fresh and creative ideas and therefore you will excel in the tasks you perform. Since you will be eager to take initiatives, work pressure will pile up, says Ganesha. You have to be confident under tremendous pressure.

You are in hot water, but do not lose hope during these turbulent times. Maintain a calm head over your shoulders and deal with the problems, guides Ganesha. Also, do not jump to conclusions or be argumentative with the people around you, as you may end up being at the losing end. Your life partner will depend on you and you tend to worry about your future. You will let your partner indulge in a joint decision-making to root out any difference in opinions or disagreements. A stable harmonious family life is what you love to see, feels Ganesha. You are not at your best energy level today. You must take rest. This is good day for taking indoor activities like watching movies, reading books. You should not pay attention to things which can be done later. You should relax and recharge yourself. Today you will be very interested in spending money on your vehicle or house. You should be open-minded and not conservative if you really want to see value of money spent behind vehicle or house. You should work on daily activities today and leave the handling of important meetings to your teammates. Your objective is to ensure smooth functioning of the current project. You will be confident in your tasks. Good thing is that you will not be in a hurry since you believe in steady progress.

You are in for a challenging day today. But, luck is by your side and you will be able to come out of the storm hale and hearty, assures Ganesha. If you are a businessman, you may enter into some major business venture, sign important contracts and take up new projects. It will be an exhausting day, but it will keep you charged up. Lucky Colour Deep Electric Blue Your optimistic attitude is likely to impress your beloved and promises you a rejuvenated love life. Your enthusiastic mindset will create a positive aura around your loved one. You will have a happy and harmonious evening with your sweetheart, foresees Ganesha. Your mind will be very active. You will be applying logic to things. Try to be flexible in your thinking because if you try to resist things/thoughts, your energy will be wasted. You must remain open-minded in your approach. This is not a great day for financial gains. Stick to routine practices and do not expect much from anything. Tendency to take risks would be very high today, so you must not get into risky investments. Creativity will encourage you to achieve even complexities in professional life. With your mind brimming with new ideas, you should find it easy to handle creative tasks. Once the creative ideas are effectively implemented, you will invest much time in decoding complex technical issues.

A day of mixed fortunes awaits you, where taking risks could prove to be your undoing, or provide you with handsome returns, says Ganesha. This is because you could come out on top by treading cautiously, but uncalculated risks will probably throw your calculations out of gear. Your success rate is unlikely to be too high; hence it may be a tough day for you. However, it will end on a promising note. Misunderstanding is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. Differences of opinions are likely to misguide you. Try to be faithful to your sweetheart and clear out all issues obstructing your way to a blissful relationship, suggest Ganesha. You may engage in fun activities with your lover. Today you should avoid getting frustrated by small small things. Disappointments, rejections or incomplete tasks may make you feel upset emotionally. You must not ‘give up’ and keep trying for things that you wish to achieve. Try to be happy and balanced. Today is good day for money matters. You will be able to see the worth of your invested money. You may also feel proud of what you have in your bank account or in terms of assets. It’s the best time to request for an appraisal, though it may come after some time. You may occupy with some busy routines as you will work closely with your teammates and seniors. Professional life seems to be quite tough for you as you may have to take some tough decisions.
